title: Hofilena Ancestral House
scope: The standing 1934 Hofileña Ancestral House exterior, including the open double-storey front porch and its attached carriage terrace.
limitations: Rear elevations are estimated. Fine iron scrollwork, carved panels and the paint weathering are generalized.
The garden, furnishings and surrounding buildings are outside the house model.
The elevation field is coarser than the front steps and driveway.
